claim: In the matching retail DLL, MatchMain.SetAfterMatchBGM (0x06004924) is an instance one-Int32-parameter method with an exact 195-byte body. It loads GlobalWork.inst.MatchSetting and PlayerMan.inst.GetPlObj(pl_idx), then writes this.ThemeMusic = player.WresParam.themeMusic and this.ThemeMusicFilename = String.Empty. It selects MatchSetting.matchWrestlerInfo[pl_idx] and initializes a data local to null. When that entry's wrestlerID is raw 10000 or greater it replaces the local with SaveData.inst.GetEditWrestlerData(wrestlerID). Otherwise, only when wrestlerID is raw -2, it replaces the local with SaveData.get_story_data().m_pc. If the resulting local is null or its EditWrestlerData.ThemeMusic_Filename is null/empty, the method returns while preserving the initial ThemeMusic and empty filename. Otherwise it calls MyMusic.Check_File(ThemeMusic_Filename). When that call is true it writes ThemeMusic=-2 and copies ThemeMusic_Filename into this.ThemeMusicFilename; when false it writes ThemeMusic=0. FACT-0093 pins the already-canonical caller at Referee.ProcesskMatchEnd_Normal IL+0x0062 with the selected raw player index.
